crossRefs.note: Then Ehud went out onto the porch, and shut the doors of the upper room on him, and locked them.

people.name: Ehud
people.line: Left-handed Benjamite judge who delivered Israel from Moabite oppression

translations.web: Then Ehud went out onto the porch, and shut the doors of the upper room on him, and locked them.
translations.bsb: Then Ehud went out through the porch, closing and locking the doors of the upper room behind him.
translations.kjv: Then Ehud went forth through the porch, and shut the doors of the parlour upon him, and locked
translations.asv: Then Ehud went forth into the porch, and shut the doors of the upper room upon him, and locked them.
